summary: The filing is a Form 6-K press release by ATS Corporation announcing its participation in the Stifel Summer Solstice Conference, where management will hold institutional investor meetings. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change events. The announcement is a routine conference participation disclosure with no special-situation transaction.
